data.narrative:
Iambic Therapeutics is a Series B biotech company that has raised $350M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 4 private peers in the same sector and stage proximity—Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B)—alongside 3 public biotech names (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) for market context.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $350M raised proxy and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage multiplier of 1.9x, implies a valuation of $665M. Peer-median anchoring across the 4 comps yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring (P/S median of 5.5x for the biotech sector) cannot be applied owing to the absence of revenue disclosure for private companies.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $565M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $2.1B across the two applicable methods. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around which peer set best reflects Iambic's stage and capital intensity; the Series B comp (Eikon at $539M) anchors the floor, while Series C peers suggest substantially higher valuations. Key unknowns include Iambic's clinical-stage progress, cash burn, and IP strength relative to peers.
